name: Scroll Reveal
description: Elements animate in as they enter viewport during scroll
framework_notes: Use IntersectionObserver or GSAP ScrollTrigger for performance

name: Stagger Animation
description: Sequential animation of multiple elements with offset timing
framework_notes: Apply stagger to parent container animate children with delay

name: Parallax Scrolling
description: Different scroll speeds creating depth illusion
framework_notes: Use transform: translateY with scroll offset keep GPU accelerated

name: Fade In Up
description: Elements fade in and slide up from below"
framework_notes: Combine opacity 0 to 1 with translateY 20px to 0

name: Scale On Hover
description: Elements scale up slightly on hover for feedback
framework_notes: Use transform: scale 1.02-1.05 with transition keep subtle

name: Slide In Left
description: Elements slide in from the left side
framework_notes: Use translateX -100px to 0 with opacity transition

name: Slide In Right
description: Elements slide in from the right side
framework_notes: Use translateX 100px to 0 with opacity transition

name: Rotate In
description: Elements rotate into view from a starting angle
framework_notes: Use rotate from 5-10 degrees to 0 with opacity

name: Blur Reveal
description: Elements transition from blurred to clear state
best_for: Image reveals, text reveals, premium feel
framework_notes: Use filter: blur from 10px to 0 keep performance in mind

name: Text Split
description: Individual characters animate separately for kinetic type
framework_notes: Split text into spans animate each with stagger

name: Counter Animation
description: Numbers count up from 0 to target value
framework_notes: Use requestAnimationFrame for smooth counting

name: Progress Bar Fill
description: Animated progress bars filling to target percentage
framework_notes: Animate width from 0 to target with easing

name: Typewriter Effect
description: Text appears character by character like typing
framework_notes: Use setTimeout or GSAP for character-by-character reveal

name: Bounce In
description: Elements enter with a bouncy overshoot effect
framework_notes: Use elastic or backOut easing for bounce feel

name: Flip Animation
description: Elements flip between front and back faces
framework_notes: Use rotateY 180deg with transform-style preserve-3d

name: Draw SVG Path
description: SVG paths animate as if being drawn
framework_notes: Use stroke-dasharray and stroke-dashoffset animation

name: Morph Shape
description: Smooth transition between different SVG shapes
framework_notes: Use SVG path morphing or clip-path transitions

name: Magnetic Hover
description: Elements subtly follow cursor on hover
framework_notes: Calculate cursor offset and apply transform translation

name: Smooth Scroll
description: Natural smooth scrolling behavior throughout page
framework_notes: Use CSS scroll-behavior smooth or GSAP ScrollSmoother

name: Parallax Image
description: Images move at different speeds within their containers
framework_notes: Apply transform based on scroll position relative to container
